name: kotonoha
_workspaces_omitted: Intentionally NOT declaring `workspaces` here. With workspace mode bun hoists node_modules to the repo root, which breaks `node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js` invocations inside `backend/crates/kotonoha-server/web/` on CI (vite ends up under the root, not under web/). kanade-backend/web doesn't declare workspaces either — install + build happen inside the web/ dir and node_modules stays local.
